Company Description Butterfly Chocolate Co. is Kuwait’s foremost luxury chocolate house, known for combining emotion, craftsmanship, and precision to create refined chocolate and pastry experiences. Founded from a family tradition and established as a boutique enterprise in 2019, Butterfly has earned a reputation for elegance and quality in premium confectionery. Each product is crafted in a dedicated central kitchen using carefully selected ingredients and a design-led philosophy focused on detail and distinction. The brand serves a discerning clientele through wedding collections, private lounges, premium gifting, and seasonal exclusives, and partners with leading institutions such as FLOWARD, GIG, KFH Capital, and First Abu Dhabi Bank. Butterfly represents Kuwaiti excellence in luxury, offering an elevated chocolate experience rooted in integrity and vision.

Role Description The Sales Associate role at Butterfly Chocolate Co. is a full-time, on-site position based in Kuwait City. The Sales Associate will welcome customers, provide product information, and guide guests in selecting luxury chocolates and gifts that match their preferences and occasions. Daily responsibilities include maintaining product displays, handling point-of-sale transactions, processing orders, and ensuring a clean and organized retail environment. The role also involves responding to customer inquiries, supporting corporate and event orders, and collaborating with the team to meet sales targets. The Sales Associate will represent Butterfly’s brand values through attentive service, product knowledge, and a focus on delivering a premium customer experience.
q: Strong customer service and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and provide personalized assistance.

Ability to work on-site in Kuwait City, including weekends, evenings, and peak seasons as needed.
Interest in luxury products, food, or hospitality; prior experience in high-end retail, cafés, or hospitality is a plus.
High level of reliability, professionalism, and a collaborative approach to working in a team environment.
High school diploma or equivalent; further education in business
